roles.title: Lead Architect
roles.summary: Lead Architect for a hardware-enforced identity platform used by organisations that can't afford to be wrong — government, defence, healthcare, finance, critical infrastructure. Cryptographic verification at person, device, and platform level, anchored in hardware rather than copyable software credentials.

roles.title: Lead Architect
roles.summary: Lead Architect for a hardware-anchored identity and authentication platform — nearly eight years of system design across secure devices, cloud services, and enterprise integration.

roles.title: Lead Developer and Architect
roles.summary: Lead Developer and Architect for a Windows video-transcoding and DIT tool — ProRes on Windows, H.265/HEVC, and high-volume media ingestion for editors, colourists, and post-production.

roles.title: Lead Applications Developer & Integration Architect
roles.summary: Nearly ten years at an advertising-content delivery company, moving from computational programming and design through UX team lead to leading applications development and integration architecture. C#/.NET, media processing, and broadcaster integrations across AU/NZ.
highlights: Computational Programmer and Designer (2008–2012), Team Lead — UX / C# Developer (2012–2014), then Lead Applications Developer & Integration Architect (2014–2018).
